maudhui: (1) There shall be a Parliament of the United Republic which shall consist of two parts, namely the President and the Members of Parliament. (2) The Parliament shall consist of all categories of members specified in Article 66 of this Constitution, all of whom shall be called Members of Parliament. (3) Where any matter requires to be decided or done by both parts of Parliament in accordance with this Constitution or any other law, that matter shall not be deemed to have been duly decided or done unless it has been decided or done by the Members of Parliament and also by the President, in accordance with their respective authority in relation to that matter.
